The Mod Store moves onto the main menu. @bluefireF5ran played it as soon as it opened and sent a list of what would make it better. This release has all five: a menu entry, Extras and Credits tabs, search with tags, and settings for where mods sit in your lists and whether they start unlocked. On Android, the store opens and installs packs again.

the store's first open, and every install.

The Mod Store moves up front

Issue #734 · PR #737

@bluefireF5ran played the store and wrote up what it needed. It now has its own button on the main menu, and on tablets and desktops a storefront icon in the title bar. Back from the store goes to the title screen.

Find a pack

  • Search matches every word against a pack's name, creator, summary, kind and tags, ignoring case and accents.
  • Sort A to Z or Newest.
  • Tag chips narrow the list, most used first, and Clear resets everything. The store's packs get their tags soon.
  • A pad or keyboard reaches every control, and the store reads in Spanish too.

New tabs

  • Extras replaces House rules. It holds every pack that isn't a hero or a scenario: house rules, modular sets, art and whatever comes next.
  • Campaign packs sit with Scenarios.
  • Credits lists every creator with the packs they made. Pick a name to see their packs.

Mods can sit with the official content now. Settings ▸ More ▸ Custom content puts installed heroes and scenarios at the top or the bottom of your lists, or mixed in beside the wave each pack names. A second switch decides whether mods start unlocked.

Custom content your way

  • Custom content in the lists: Top, Bottom (the default, as before) or Mixed in. A pack that names no wave stays at the bottom.
  • Custom content starts unlocked: on by default. Turn it off and each pack's heroes and scenarios unlock the way its creator chose: open, with champion points like an official hero, or free once you've won 5 different scenarios.
  • A pack's campaigns stay open either way.
  • Mod content wears a MOD PACK badge instead of CUSTOM.

For creators

  • pack.json takes three new optional fields: tags (up to 8), wave and unlock (open, points or wins).
  • The mod SDK's mc-pack validate and build check them.
  • The store's packs now live and publish in the mods registry, each with the same id and every version it had, so installs and saved games carry on.

Look around a replay

Issue #735 · PR #742

A controller can stop a replay and walk the table. Press down on the d-pad (or ↓ on the keyboard), or the new magnifier on the replay bar, and the replay pauses and the bar steps aside. Nothing you press is played.

On the table

  • The d-pad moves focus, Y inspects a card (hold to zoom) and A reads it.
  • LB and RB jump between zones, View opens the recap or the log, and R3 lists the decks.
  • Back to replay (B, Esc or Start) brings the bar back where it was.

Dark mode on a pad

  • On the table, the dark mode button is a stop just before the music, and A flips it.
  • On every other screen, press up from the top of the screen to reach it, A to flip it, and down to go back where you were.

You asked, we fixed

Issues #733 and #738 · PRs #736 and #740

The Mod Store works on Android again, and community heroes show their pictures from the first deal. Thank you, @zackburnley, for the Android report.

#733 · reported by @zackburnley

The store opens

The first time the store opened on Android, the game stopped after Deadpool's line, with no buttons and no way back. The two portraits asked for a picture larger than many phones can draw. They are baked as round pictures now, and so is the Team-Up info portrait, which had the same problem.

Found while fixing #733

Packs install

In v0.45.0 no pack would install on Android: "The download failed". The size check counted line breaks in the download as data, so every pack looked a little too big. Every pack installs now.

#738 · found in play

Pack pictures show up

A community hero's cards could stay blank on the opening hand until you kept it, and Gwenpool's table card showed her hero side while she was in alter-ego form. Both now redraw as soon as the pack's pictures load.

Also in v0.46.0

Behind the scenes
  • The community packs moved from the game's repository to the mods registry, which publishes them now. Nothing changes in the game.
  • The mod SDK, @champions-digital-game/mod-sdk, publishes to npm with each release through npm's trusted publishing, so creators get each version the day it ships.

Thank you!

This release is built on what you played and reported. Keep it coming from Pause ▸ Report a problem, a GitHub issue or the community Discord.
